summary: Editas Medicine filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing receipt of regulatory and ethics approval to initiate the Phase 1/2 Strive trial of EDIT-401 in heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, first in Australia via Human Research Ethics Committee approval and completion of the Therapeutic Goods Administration Clinical Trial Notification, with a submission pending in New Zealand; if cleared, patients in both countries may enroll. EDIT-401 is an in vivo LDLR-upregulation gene editing candidate; preclinical non-human primate data showed roughly 90% mean reductions in LDL-C, Lp(a), and ApoB sustained about 10 months. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated; the filing is a routine clinical/regulatory update, not a special situation.
